hooks.command:
m="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.beads-tasks/mail.sh"; if [ -x "$m" ]; then u=$("$m" unread 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$u" ]; then n=$(printf "%s
" "$u" | wc -l | tr -d " "); printf "Unread agent mail: %s, newest 3 shown (all: ./.beads-tasks/mail.sh unread; peek <id> reads without marking read):
" "$n"; printf "%s
" "$u" | head -n 3; fi; fi; if command -v bd >/dev/null 2>&1; then c=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bd list --status in_progress --json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | "  \(.id)  [\(.assignee // "unclaimed")]  \(.title)"' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$c" ] && printf "Beads in progress (claimed as worktree@branch):
%s
" "$c"; fi; exit 0
